content:
Of course — I can help.

What’s the email about, and who is it going to? If you can, share:
- The purpose of the email
- The recipient/relationship
- Any key points to include
- Desired tone: professional, friendly, firm, apologetic, etc.
- Any deadline or call to action

If you want, you can also paste a rough draft and I’ll polish it.
